text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: That's not it!! It's a misunderstanding!?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I got prooooper permission from the 
academy to be here today! Wow, what a 
relieeef☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Master was invited to give a lecture on 
bamboo needles. So I had to run 
err—*ahem*! Came along as an assistant, 
don't'cha know☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, that's right! Running into each other 
here must be fate!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
How about you too, Trainer? Just one quick 
jab! I prooooomise it won't hurt at all~!! 
Come on, please, pleeease~!!
